answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1653 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lantern. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the nectar queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. The mesa index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 12 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
